root_cause: QuickBooks lacked method setup labels/environment/realm form fields and a canonical credential probe binding required by the host.
owner: QuickBooks catalog owns setup facts; provider-local probe function delegates public CompanyInfo action and existing validator/transport. Shared probe boundary handles input validation and safe errors.
setup: Both methods require explicit sandbox/production environment and string realm_id with numeric 1-32 digit schema; no defaults. External oauth2_token remains access-token-only, and OAuth protocol facts are unchanged.
probe: Returns optional display_name plus metadata.company_id, configured_realm_id and environment; provider_account_id null, no grants/scopes. CompanyInfo.Id is not the realm. Errors retain only allowlisted reason and numeric status, with fixed safe messages.

preservation.invoice_precision_and_endpoint_behavior: Existing action/transport/response source unchanged; focused QBO regression tests passed.

focused_slice.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/quickbooks_online tests/auth tests/catalog tests/packaging -q

installed_wheel.environment: Disposable evidence/wheel-venv; dependency-only site path reused from connector development venv. Driver asserts all package origins inside wheel-venv purelib, no StackOS package, and blocks live sockets. No installed host/runtime environment changed.

side_effects: Only isolated connector branch/worktree, local commit, synthetic focused checks, distribution build and disposable wheel smoke environment. No full suite, live provider, publication, push, host source edit, lifecycle action or StackOS state mutation.
